class.name: CanvasGroup
class.brief_description: Merges several 2D nodes into a single draw operation.

members.member: Sets the size of the margin used to expand the clearing rect of this [CanvasGroup]. This expands the area of the backbuffer that will be used by the [CanvasGroup]. A smaller margin reduces the backbuffer area and can improve performance. Keep this as small as possible, but increase it if custom effects produce artifacts along the edges of the canvas group.

If [code]true[/code], this Layer uses the nearest lower sibling Layer that does not have [member clipping_mask] enabled as its Clipping Base. The Layer changes color only within the Base's resulting alpha, and cannot change the Clipping Stack's alpha. An orphaned clipped Layer renders with zero coverage.

Sets the size of a margin used to expand the drawable rect of this [CanvasGroup]. The size of the [CanvasGroup] is determined by fitting a rect around its children then expanding that rect by [member fit_margin]. This increases both the backbuffer area used and the area covered by the [CanvasGroup] both of which can reduce performance. This should be kept as small as possible and should only be expanded when an increased size is needed (e.g. for custom shader effects).
Selects how this Layer's combined result is composited with lower sibling Layers. [constant LAYER_BLEND_MODE_DEFAULT] uses the effective canvas shader's [code]render_mode blend_*[/code] declaration.
Retained for scene and script compatibility. The property value is serialized, but mipmap generation is disabled and setting this property to [code]true[/code] emits a warning.

constants.constant: Uses the effective canvas shader's blend declaration. The default canvas shader uses Normal blending.
Adds the associated source color to the destination while preserving source-over alpha coverage.
Multiplies source and destination colors with correct partially transparent edge behavior.
Represents the size of the [enum LayerBlendMode] enum.
